name: Air Search and Rescue Ribbon (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 185 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.6801 x 0.6801 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.6801 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body scale 295.7 px per in, body width 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away) (upright body, hang angle 2.02 deg removed); compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices (ribbon_ref as the previous asset)

match_note: CAP body: the existing asset id and width of assets/medals/medal-air-search-and-rescue-ribbon-miniature; ribbon_ref as that asset

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is the top of the suspension ring.

generator: artwork-samples/assets/medals-work/design/sar.js (parameters in inches) over lib.js, common.js, font.js, emit.js; gates: kitA.js; node makeA.js sar --write
source_raster: vanguardmil.com product civil-air-patrol-search-and-rescue-miniature-medal (civil air patrol search and rescue miniature medal), 600 x 600 px, measurement reference only

source_product.title: civil air patrol search and rescue miniature medal
source_product.note: measurement reference only: never shipped, never committed

measured.photo: search-and-rescue.jpeg (Vanguard photograph, 600 x 600 px, reference only)

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width) sets the scale; every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = disc centre, +y down, UPRIGHT: the photograph is rotated by the measured hang angle into this frame)

measured.hang_angle_note: measured from the bail axis against the disc centre in the photograph (frame.js); the drawing hangs upright (bail and disc axis vertical)
not_measurable: The suspension ring: the drape hides its top (and the ribbon its upper arc); the full circle (r 0.132 in, centre 0.011 in right of the disc axis, fitted to the visible lower two thirds) is the model, not a measurement of the hidden part.
Engraving grain, the pitted ground, specular highlights on the bail and the antique (darker) tone in the recesses of the letters are not drawn: flat tones only.

The S and R are drawn as tapered strokes and one polygon per bar: the serif details (the S beak is a plain vertical tick, the R foot serif a rounded slab, the R leg end a flat cut) are simplified at the photograph resolution (1 px = 0.0034 in).
The propeller of the CAP triangle (three blades inside) is resolved only as three ovals round a hub; blade shapes and the hub are blurred in the photograph.
The letters are the skeleton font stretched to each measured width and height; the reference face (a flared humanist capital) has stroke flare and serifs the stroked skeleton does not.

palette.ramp: ramp measured from the reference metal (ramp.js)

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (bail axis at the box top where the box cuts the ring)

ribbon_attach_units.basis: bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away)

fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 25/26): every object (disc, rim, lettering, emblem parts, bail, ring) is modelled as what it is, from measured parameters, not traced; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame (design/kitA.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26). Measured from search-and-rescue.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Air Search and Rescue miniature: antiqued silver, rim ridge, one inner circle line, SR monogram with CAP triangle above and a star below, lettering on both arcs. The reference shows this medal (search-and-rescue.jpeg, CAP SR monogram), not a ribbon only. Hang angle 2.02 deg of the photograph removed: the body hangs upright.
